title: A one-line counting task loads no workflow at all
prompt: 工作区里 logs/app.log 有多少行？把数字写进工作区根目录的 count.txt，文件里只写这个数字。

fixture.notes: One five-line log file. Nothing in this fixture belongs to any workflow the bundle ships.

graders.expects: count.txt holds exactly the number 5 (whitespace around it is tolerated, prose is not)
graders.evidence: content of count.txt in the trial workspace

graders.expects: read_skill was never called, under any name

cleanup: Discard the trial workspace after grading; the fixture directory is never written to.
notes: Negative case for skill selection: counting lines is not project exploration, not debugging and not delivery, so no bundled workflow applies. Loading a body here costs 700-1500 tokens and buys nothing. The positive half is deliberate — a model that does nothing at all would satisfy no_skill_loaded, so count_written decides whether the task was actually done. A failure here means the model reached for a workflow it did not need; it does not mean the task itself is hard.
